hero.title: Class Registration

login_required_desc: You must be logged in to submit a course registration. Please log in and try again.

section_plan.title: 3. Plan Length · Frequency · Lesson Time
section_plan.zoom_50min_notice: A 50-minute Zoom class runs as 25 minutes · 5-minute break · 25 minutes. For an uninterrupted 50-minute class, we recommend VooV Meeting or Teams instead.

section_weekday.title: 4. Class Days
section_weekday.value_label: Default class days for your selection
section_weekday.custom_note: Want weekend classes or a different day pattern? Message our manager directly through one of the channels below.

section_points.title: 5. Loyalty Points Discount
section_points.apply_checkbox: Apply my full points balance as a discount
section_points.guest_note: Only a logged-in student account can check and use points.
section_points.earn_note: Points are earned when a friend you refer registers (5,000P to you) or when you write a review (1,000P).

price_preview.krw_only_note: The points discount is calculated based on KRW payment.
price_preview.disclaimer: * The final amount may differ after a consultation, depending on promotions or family discounts.

section_schedule.title: 6. Preferred Start Date · Time
section_schedule.time_zone_note: Korea Standard Time (KST), selectable in 30-minute increments from 6:00 AM to midnight.
